description_en: Submits an asynchronous commit for a full export node of inventory knowledge
description_zh: 异步提交盘点知识全量导出任务
name: AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inventory task
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The search keyword used for fuzzy matching against knowledge content
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配知识内容
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The knowledge display type used to filter results, such as TABLE, COLUMN, SQL, SEG, LINEAGE, or TERM
parameters.help_zh: 知识展示类型筛选，如 TABLE、COLUMN、SQL、SEG、LINEAGE、TERM 等
parameters.name: show_type

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results. Valid values: confidence and entityId. Default value: confidence
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order.

Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向，可选值：asc（正序）、desc（倒序），默认desc
parameters.name: sort_order

Data.description_en: The ID of the inventory task

ExportTaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous export task. Use this ID to poll the task status by calling GetInventoryExportTaskStatus
ExportTaskId.description_zh: 异步导出任务 ID，用于 GetInventoryExportTaskStatus 轮询
ExportTaskId.title_en: 异步导出任务 ID，用于 GetInventoryExportTaskStatus 轮询
ExportTaskId.title_zh: 异步导出任务 ID，用于 GetInventoryExportTaskStatus 轮询

FileName.description_en: The suggested file name for saving the exported file

Status.description_en: The status of the task. The value is RUNNING when the task is submitted
Status.description_zh: 任务状态，提交成功时为 RUNNING
Status.title_en: 任务状态，提交成功时为 RUNNING
Status.title_zh: 任务状态，提交成功时为 RUNNING

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
